title: A Different Group Meeting

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并逐词逐题对照语境复核。
source.reviewScope: Foundational A0/A1 practice, author-estimated difficulty. Final source senses,64objective questions and explicit package wording revisions reviewed. Synthetic en-US audio source/bytes/decoding/roles/pause checks and unprompted ASR retained;4recognition differences are not declared phonemically verified.

questions.evidence: We meet our English group at six.
questions.explanation: Ava 说她的小组六点见面；十点属于阅读中的另一组，四和三是听力里的数量。

questions.prompt: How many students are in Ava’s group?
questions.evidence: There are four students in this group.
questions.explanation: 听力小组有四名学生；三是教科书数量，五是便条上的名字数，六属于阅读小组。

questions.prompt: How many notebooks are on the table?
questions.evidence: Two notebooks are on this table.
questions.explanation: 这张桌上有两本笔记本；三本是教科书，四和五是其他数量。
Tom 说老师有记号笔；没有说 Ava、Tom 或 Ben 拿着它。

questions.prompt: What does Ava say they can write?
questions.evidence: We can open our books and write our names.
questions.explanation: Ava 说他们可以打开书写自己的名字；没有提出写十个问题、地址或五个声音。

questions.prompt: Why does Tom ask Ava to speak again?
options: He wants to change the meeting time.
He does not understand one sound.
answers: He does not understand one sound.
questions.evidence: I do not understand one sound. Can you speak again, please?
questions.explanation: Tom 不理解一个声音，所以请 Ava 再说一遍；没有说要改时间、丢了书或换便条。

questions.prompt: What name does Ava help Tom spell?
questions.explanation: Ava 说要拼写的名字是 Ben；Ava 和 Tom 是谈话者，Lee 没有被说成这个名字。

questions.prompt: Who does Tom ask to check his work?
questions.evidence: I ask the teacher to check my work.
questions.explanation: Tom 说他请老师检查作业；Ava 也说老师可以帮助他们，没有指定其他选项中的人检查。

questions.prompt: How long is the short task?
questions.evidence: We have ten minutes for a short task.
questions.explanation: 短任务有十分钟；三、四、五是其他数字，不是任务时长。

questions.prompt: How many names are on Tom’s note?
questions.evidence: I have five names on my note, but I read only one name first.
questions.explanation: Tom 的便条上有五个名字，他先只读一个；两个是笔记本数量，三个是教科书数量。

instructions: 先按对话分段听人物与数字，再独立作答；订正时回听对应片段。
transcript:
Ava: Hello. My name is Ava. We meet our English group at six. There are four students in this group. What is your name?

Tom: My name is Tom. I am a new student too. Three textbooks are on that table. Two notebooks are on this table. The teacher has a marker.

Ava: Please sit here, Tom. This is my notebook. Is that your textbook? We can open our books and write our names. I can show you my note.

Tom: Yes, this is my textbook. I have a question. I do not understand one sound. Can you speak again, please? I want to check the sound before I read.

Ava: Yes. Listen to the sound. I can help you spell the name. The name is Ben. It has three letters. We can say the letters together.

Tom: Thank you, Ava. I can spell Ben now. I write the name in my notebook. I ask the teacher to check my work.

Ava: Yes. The teacher can help us. We have ten minutes for a short task. Please read the note and then stand near the group. We can speak to the other students. The teacher shows us the next part. We can listen together. It is fine to ask for help.

Tom: Thank you. I have five names on my note, but I read only one name first. Then we can ask the teacher another question.
